name: contextlean
description: Bootstrap, maintain, and honestly measure repository context for focused coding-agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap once. Read less. Change locally.
interface.longDescription: Configure repository maps once, audit them over time, review changes for unnecessary complexity, and measure context impact with static or controlled A/B benchmarks.
defaultPrompt: Use $contextlean:audit to audit this repository without changing it.
Use $contextlean:lean-review to review my current change without editing it.
